messages:
maria: getting a burn-rate alert for prod-auth SLO ~3x. Anyone know the quick dashboards or traces to check? last deploy was kaniko:20261104 ~24h ago. oncall ping

oncall-bot: Alert: SLO burn rate (prod-auth) 3.2x — triggered 2026-11-05T14:12:18Z — incident=INC-4321 — severity=warning

sam: start w/ Grafana overview: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/prod-auth/slo-overview — check 'SLO burn', 'errors by code', and 'token-latency p95' panels

jordan: also open Honeycomb: https://ui.honeycomb.io/redwood/datasets/prod-traces — filter service=auth and span=/v1/auth/token

maria: can someone paste the Loki query for 5xx error rate? want to grab a window quickly

sam: Loki snippet (approx):
```
{job="auth"} |= "status=5" | json | count_over_time({job="auth"}[1m])
```
use 1m then expand to 10m for smoothing

maria: ran that, looks like 503 spike from nginx-ingress between 14:00-14:07 — ~170-190 errors/min peaked

jordan: sounds upstream / timeouty. For alerts i'd adjust window->10m and threshold->2.5x burn (prod-only) so transient spikes don't noisy-pager. Also scope to error codes 502/503/504 if possible

maria: agree, low-risk to tune. who can update alert-config?

jordan: i'll open a quick PR to infra/alerts — will change: window=10m, multiplier=2.5, scope=prod-auth, add excluded 500s from non-prod sources

jordan: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/alerts/pulls/1287 — small change + unit test for rule

sam: lgtm on PR, will watch for next 45m and follow up if it persists. added temporary dashboard annotation at 14:12 UTC

oncall-bot: Note: deploy 'kaniko:20261104' happened 2026-11-04T21:03Z (deployed-by @deploy-bot)

maria: if spike continues we'll consider rolling back that image tag, but for now tuning alerts seems fine — thanks both :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Alert resolved 2026-11-05T14:28:34Z — burn rate back to 0.9x — incident=INC-4321

maria: closing loop here. i'll add a short note to INC-4321 and only escalate to a full postmortem if it recurs. saved grafana snapshot & honeycomb trace ids in the ticket

sam: added grafana snapshot https://grafana.redwood.ai/snapshot/abcd1234 and trace link https://ui.honeycomb.io/redwood/trace/xyz789

jordan: thanks — PR merged and alert-config deployed. will monitor 24h and we can revert if we see missed signals. closing thread.
